Figure S4. Synthetic-accessibility prediction on molecules from three generators not represented in the GESA training sources. (a–c) AUROC point estimates for the NEAT-POCKET, FLOWR, and ResGen cohorts, respectively, sampled without SAScore restriction. (d–f) Corresponding results within the fixed SAScore [3,4) range. For each generator, 50 molecules were requested per pocket across the same 20 prespecified pockets; final sample sizes and numbers of pockets with evaluable molecules varied with generation yield and quality control. Exact matches to the audited model-development datasets were excluded. Retro* labels were assigned using the same planning protocol as the original analysis; planning timeouts and execution errors were excluded from evaluation. All nine methods were compared on the same evaluable molecules within each panel, with HS as the positive class. The three highest AUROC point estimates are displayed, including ties at the cutoff. Panel annotations give the evaluation sample size, ES/HS counts, and number of pockets. A dagger indicates fewer than 20 molecules in either class. Complete nine-method AUROC/AP estimates, 95% confidence intervals from 2,000 pocket-level bootstrap replicates, and paired comparisons are provided in the accompanying source data.

图S4. GESA训练来源中未包含的三个生成器所生成分子的合成可及性预测。（a–c）分别为NEAT-POCKET、FLOWR及ResGen在未限制SAScore的采样集合上的AUROC点估计；（d–f）为对应的固定SAScore [3,4)子集结果。每个生成器均在预先固定的相同20个口袋中请求每口袋50个分子；最终样本数及包含有效评价分子的口袋数因生成产出和质控而不同。排除与已审计的模型开发数据精确重合的分子。Retro*标签采用原分析相同的规划规则，规划超时和执行错误不纳入评价。每个面板内九种方法均在相同分子上比较，HS为正类。图中展示AUROC点估计最高的三种方法，包含第三名处的并列。面板标注评价样本数、ES/HS数量及口袋数。†表示某一类别少于20个分子。完整九方法AUROC/AP、2,000次口袋级bootstrap所得95%置信区间及配对比较见随附源数据。
